description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §2.13, §5.9, §5.10, decision 27): who walks the Greywood's rides while the giant is there - at most two at once, one every 60-120 s, 120-220 m away, out of view, on a ride's node (never in Hollowmere, never by a placed fight that is not cleared). Dire wolves and troll pairs for a giant of stage 4 and up; once the Matriarch fled the den (boss.matriarch.outcome = fled: the oath's drive) her scattered brood roams as a troll pack for a giant of stage 5 and up; the woodfolk's hunters (neutral while Hollowmere is at peace) at any stage. Each entry's members pay kill XP for its first three spawns only (wander.greywood.<entry>.spawns).
